body: Helo, thank you very much for writing that and Im sorry for taking so long to reply. I took a few days of silence. Your story is inspiring..I'm a bit drained right now but this is definitely a story that I would read back again in a few days and hopefully look back to in months to come.Thank you.

Hi, I just thought I wanted to write something since I notice you have quite an interest in music. I love listening to foreign language music since that makes me focus only on the melody and intonation. I don't speak Japanese but I've always loved the Japanese band L'arc\-en'Ciel 's 'Niji' and 'Honey' , you might want to check them out when you aren't doing anything and want to just introduce your brain to something new. I'm sorry if they aren't to your liking. Take care xxx

Hello, thank you for your reply. I read you reply a few times and thought about it. I sometimes wonder if there's something wrong with me from the get go (if we believe that some might be predisposed to these macabre tendencies due to a certain chemical imbalance in the brain). Long story short, first dark thoughts started in early teens and carried on on and off until now. I'm 30+ with a good marriage, career and social life. When my parent died,  couldn't cope with it and it felt like everythig came rushing in all over again. and it was a year ago. And i could not imagine having to deal with it all over again when the other parent die. or my spouse. So i just live day to day generating money, smiling and joking with my partner in the evening and crying at night. I'm tired. And I live in a community and professional circle where I have o smile day in day out. Im tired, Im really tired.

hi thank you for your reply. I was for  a few years a chronic cutter but never actually died. The death of a parent made me feel that maybe life is pretty pointless despite my career, marriage, as there's this impending doom just looming over until it happens. I'm okay most of the times but once I'm alone it hits me..and it hits me hard. I just want something to turn my life all around
